question: Should ClawHub enforce the linked PR's proposed 40-character skill display-name limit, and should unchanged existing over-limit hosted or GitHub-backed titles be preserved?
rationale: Current main has no title cap, and the remaining blocker is the public metadata policy plus compatibility behavior for existing long names rather than an unknown code path.

options.title: Adopt 40 with grandfathering
options.body: Proceed with a shared 40-character limit for new or renamed titles while preserving unchanged existing over-limit titles unless explicitly migrated.

options.title: Choose a different cap
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask the implementation PR to adjust the shared constant, tests, and docs to the maintainer-selected maximum.

options.title: Do not enforce a cap
options.body: Close or reframe the request if maintainers decide title length should remain editorial guidance rather than a write-path rule.

recommendation.title: Adopt 40 with grandfathering
recommendation.body: Proceed with a shared 40-character limit for new or renamed titles while preserving unchanged existing over-limit titles unless explicitly migrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest current-main history on the central publish and GitHub-backed sync paths affected by the policy choice.
